caseNameFull: Wilson Clinton, an Incompetent, etc. v. Gypsy Oil Company
attorneys: Mr. Horace H. Hagan, for plaintiffs in error, in opposition to the motion.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6. Mr. J. B. Diggs, for defendant in error, in support of the motion.
